    LIGHT_TEXT = RGBColor(234, 237, 237)
    CYAN_ACCENT = RGBColor(26, 188, 156)

    set_dark_background(slide)

This civilization was characterized by advanced urban planning, sophisticated architecture, and complex social organization, establishing foundational aspects of Indian culture, including proto-Hindu religious practices.

    The **Vedic Period** (1500–500 BCE) during the Iron Age saw the composition of the Vedas, the foundational scriptures of Hinduism, establishing key religious tenets and the *varna* system. This era was crucial for the rise of significant ascetic movements and philosophical concepts, notably Jainism (founded by Mahavira) and Buddhism (formed by Gautama Buddha), shaping the subcontinent's spiritual landscape profoundly.

    set_dark_background(slide)
    title = slide.shapes.title
    content = slide.placeholders[1]

    title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = CYAN_ACCENT

    The concept of **Secularism** is enshrined in India's constitution, describing the state as secular and prohibiting religious persecution. However, maintaining this secular fabric amidst immense religious diversity and political polarization remains a crucial aspect of governance. Festivals such as Diwali, Eid, Christmas, and Holi are celebrated with fervor nationwide, embodying the spirit of unity in diversity.

        paragraph.font.size = Pt(18)

    set_dark_background(slide)
    title = slide.shapes.title
    content = slide.placeholders[1]
    title.text = "Dynamic and Evolving Economy"

        paragraph.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    presentation.save(output_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    output_path = "C:/Users/achal/Desktop/India_Presentation.pptx"
    create_india_presentation(output_path)
